sloka: गृहीतं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो महाबलः।आजघान गदाग्रेण वक्षसि द्विविदं ततः ।। ६.७६.२९ ।।
transliteration: gṛhītaṁ bhrātaraṁ dṛṣṭvā śoṇitākṣo mahābalaḥ।ājaghāna gadāgreṇa vakṣasi dvividaṁ tataḥ ।। 6.76.29 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing the brother caught, mighty Sonitaksha struck Dwivida in the bosom by a mace.
